meaning:
νήθω
[in LXX for טָוָה, שָׁזַר hoph., Exo.26:31 35:25, al. ;]
to spin: Mat.6:28, Luk.12:27.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin,
Consider the lilies, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin; yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
